description: After 'Create API key' the button goes grey and disabled with unchanged label and no spinner for roughly 8 seconds on this dev server; the dialog looks frozen.
expected: Label changes to 'Creating...' or a spinner appears.
suggested_fix: Show progress text on submit buttons.

description: Manual path forces drive -> recovery-file dialog -> jump to Files tab -> back to API keys -> agent -> key: about 19 actions. Finishing the recovery-file dialog throws the user out of the API keys tab and the flow they started.
expected: Return to the tab the user was on after drive creation.
actual: Lands on Files with 'Recovery file saved' banner
suggested_fix: Keep the user on API keys after the recovery dialog.

description: Same repository-build wording on the API keys panel: 'Run the CLI from the repository after building it.' A user who installed from npm is told otherwise; panel also shows origin-only --api.
The recovery-file dialog repeats 'Without it nobody, including us, can open this drive.' twice and has no close control.
suggested_fix: Drop one of the two sentences.

description: Create drive dialog checkbox 'Agent-only — never add this drive to passphrase unlock' means nothing to a user with no passphrase; `+ New API key` is greyed out with no explanation until a drive and agent exist.
expected: Plain wording and a reason for disabled button.
suggested_fix: Reword; add title text to the disabled button.

description: `agent-drive login` with AGENT_DRIVE_API_KEY prints a raw JSON blob (accountId, keyId, scopes...) instead of a 'Logged in' line; `whoami` then shows localDriveKeys false with no hint that a drive key is still needed.
expected: Human sentence plus 'Set AGENT_DRIVE_KEY to read or write drive <id>'.
suggested_fix: Add a summary line after JSON or instead of it.

description: Permission checkboxes delete and share have no explanation while manage does; the user must guess what share means.
